To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
family physicians have the knowledge, skills, and attitudes to provide comprehensive care for cancer patients at all stages of the natural history.
family physicians have the knowledge, skills, and attitudes required to assume the role of primary care physician for cancer patients.
family physicians are well prepared to manage patients throughout the entire course of cancer.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification and development of a model of family practice in which family physicians can be trained to manage cancer and other chronic diseases.
the role of family physicians as the "gatekeepers" of the medical care system, as the physicians who maintain continuity of care, and as the physicians responsible for comprehensive care.
the development and validation of a theory of family practice.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
family physicians have a role in the management of all stages of cancer." (AUTHOR)
family practice residency training provides a solid foundation for the management of cancer by family physicians at all stages.
the role of the family physician in the management of the cancer patient is the same as it is in the management of all other patients.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
family physicians are well prepared by their training to assume the management of patients with cancer.
family physicians have the skills, knowledge, and experience to manage patients with all stages of cancer.
family physicians are well prepared to assume the roles of primary care physicians of cancer patients at all stages of the natural history.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the family physician is the primary care physician for the cancer patient.
family physicians have a critical role to play in the management of patients with cancer.
the family physician is a central player in the management of patients throughout the course of their cancer disease.
